name: v0.2.92
body:
## Changelog
### Bug fixes
* 0dca768b2cb48b82487c5db2e55184c58815bbd9 fix(artifacts): quote rejected request fields in the debug log
* 6646c2e63e598b6159c3c9c4c9c8bc23fb80ecf4 fix(cmd): do not follow project file symlinks out of the workdir
* a97c01648cc920117cc4e9e46f846f34fab7fdfb fix(git): anchor and escape hostnames in remote URL patterns
* 703e9d4b9be0c17ae3e9de6ee0a131ed0f8c94d1 fix(cmd): treat ./.actrc as untrusted project config
* 0c0446bbfa001da80ee981a051e4666bad6e66ab fix(runner): strip terminal control sequences from step output
* 63b392209a61691f72f5db908b42dd57a356b18c fix(runner): refuse NODE_OPTIONS from GITHUB_ENV and set-env
* 8fc492b6ede56144d211f0549db648f74a9a1dd7 fix(artifactcache): serve cache blobs through os.Root
* 3d37545b50dd3ae7c3ea5f9c3ace153cc11dfa83 fix(artifacts): contain storage, bound signed URLs, drop empty-key parsing
* 53ab38f60e7a8a1446f1ae011e9e39813d70f33d fix(container): restrict workflow container options and host volumes
* 41058850f92f35638f069f58822c9bdbcc0c5069 fix(runner): keep remote action paths inside the action repository
* 8ec74eeedf9e46baa2011a95e536ecb03b4b71be fix(container): keep host-mode file writes inside the destination
* 1dc092de58ff2478aef19e4edc438a5e5c1a5214 fix: report module pseudo and dirty versions instead of the VERSION fallback
### Documentation updates
* b962e1e10362610410df9e5ca3581308952d21e7 docs: add security audit findings and triage
* 770ad713021f5334f9a43c3ce8a5ab5668a98402 docs: host the act logo and repair broken README images
* 020ca09c6f9b758f27b3bffe283f7ea506adc593 docs: pin attestation verification to the release workflow and tag
* d68ab165c2252babd148debda5db5229a41b14ba docs: add security policy
### Other
* cba121f7681350b002a5eefa54fe223a090e5a64 refactor(runner): split action reading and volume checks out of long functions
* ec6004520a922ddfb07926f3b205229c74f7f40f ci: publish the release only after provenance is attested
* fe5c98bdf943db9083e47850af120d0aa6e0cde1 ci: run the host-test skip message under bash on every OS
* c5f5a42e00141eac5103892c3ac4fb2aecdfdcf1 ci: release by pushing only the tag
* 37c5aa959db7253f5b30d218126159353331dbbd chore(deps): bump golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0
* e1f4d7a7195c4d0a53c951defa7e8967fe85ffac ci: add Dependabot cooldown and Docker updates
* 54bdd4e2652a23387b6694b278b44cb5da542be5 ci: pin Dockerfile base images by digest
* 27f467af0953c0a35b4143fd0681432918df0b75 ci: verify Chocolatey build inputs
* 2e7e44033124b47e4d283606b99f609b3c964dff ci: attest release provenance and pin GoReleaser
* 8859a7e118e7b6ae519b4ea7f5a119e2735ffb00 ci: drop unused write scopes from checks
* d9255cf042484a9e331ccaea966ef733d376779f ci: scope workflow token permissions to jobs
